brief:
A merchant hails Grayson - who is stationary outside of Achilles base in space. 
The merchant says "hey there! new the the troy system? I don't mind giving you a quick tour if you like...?" or something like that.
The camera pans around to each of the nav points in the Troy system - with an intricate short story for each nav point.
triggers_text: This will fire the very first time Grayson launches from Achilles in Troy, like in a very fresh game.
outcome_text: Player is just chilling at Achilles - no enemies, 2 Drayman, 2 Militia Talons are around.
